# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We want NotebookLab to be a project where anyone can contribute and feel
welcome, regardless of background, identity, or experience level.

## Our standards

Expected:

- Be respectful and constructive in reviews, issues, and discussions.
- Assume good intent; ask questions before assigning blame.
- Accept feedback on your work gracefully; it is about the code, not you.

Not tolerated:

- Harassment, insults, or personal attacks of any kind.
- Publishing others' private information.
- Sustained disruption of discussions.

## Enforcement

Violations can be reported privately to the maintainers listed in the
repository profile. Reports are reviewed confidentially. Maintainers may
remove comments, reject contributions, or ban contributors whose behavior
violates this code.
